references.text: God promised to meet with Moses above the mercy seat between the cherubim and speak to him from there
The tabernacle is called the tent of meeting where God meets with Moses and speaks to him
The mercy seat above the ark of the testimony is the place where God meets with Moses
The description of the mercy seat (kapporet) and the two cherubim placed upon it
The making of the mercy seat with the two cherubim facing each other
God spoke with Moses face to face in the tent of meeting
God reveals himself in the cloud above the mercy seat
God speaks directly with Moses, mouth to mouth, not in riddles
The cherubim are first mentioned as guardians of the way to the tree of life
The Lord is enthroned above the cherubim on the ark of the covenant
God is enthroned above the cherubim and is asked to let his face shine
The Lord is king and is enthroned above the cherubim
The glorious cherubim who overshadow the mercy seat are mentioned in connection with the ark of the covenant
